question: 20261028-0433-expand-inference-u05-q06: does ModelScope grant 1 million free tokens per model for 90 days to an email-only account?
why: the 1,000,000 tokens per model for 90 days grant is the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Singapore quota, now limited to models absent from the 2026-10-29 removal list; ModelScope API-Inference is a separate free lane whose record inference/modelscope-api-inference says the account must bind a real-name verified Alibaba Cloud account; that record is outside this unit's scope and was not re-read
